emucab.configuration.traction.enabled: Apply traction to the physics train
message.emucab.reset_first: Stop and press the emergency reset button
message.emucab.interlock: Traction interlock: check supply, pantograph, VCB, direction, door release and brakes
message.emucab.neutral_first: Stop and put the controller in N first
hint.emucab.handle: Adjust traction and braking. Stop and reset after EB.
hint.emucab.screen: Independent key signal reserved for future adapters; display layout stays fixed.
hint.emucab.radio: Enter or confirm a radio channel.
hint.emucab.emergency: Apply emergency braking. Stop before resetting.
hint.emucab.ack: Acknowledge ATP and temporarily silence its warning.
hint.emucab.reset: Release emergency braking at standstill and return to N.
hint.emucab.direction: Select forward, 0 or reverse at standstill with the handle in N.
hint.emucab.master: New desks start with the key off. Switching on enables displays; switching off removes traction. Braking remains available.
hint.emucab.pantograph: Toggle raise/lower command. Lowering first opens the VCB; no position or voltage feedback.
hint.emucab.breaker: Toggle the vacuum circuit breaker. Closing requires the pantograph command raised.
hint.emucab.brake_test: At standstill, select B7 and emit a test signal.
hint.emucab.sand: Send a short sanding request to improve wheel-rail adhesion; no equipment is connected.
hint.emucab.door_left: Toggle the left door command at standstill without traction.
hint.emucab.door_right: Toggle the right door command at standstill without traction.
hint.emucab.door_close: Close both door commands and emit a pulse.
hint.emucab.wiper: Cycle off/slow/fast commands; sneak to reverse. No wiper model is connected.
hint.emucab.horn: Sound the horn and send a short request.
tooltip.emucab.drag: Hold right mouse; up for power, down for brake
tooltip.emucab.release: Release to hold notch · Esc to finish
hint.emucab.unassigned: This control is unassigned. Clicking has no effect and emits no button signal.
hint.emucab.manual_neutral: Open the VCB and remove traction; route detection and automatic reclosure are not connected.
hint.emucab.door_open_left: Requires left release, stopped and no traction. Holds the open signal at 15 until the same-side close button is pressed.
hint.emucab.door_release_left: Enable left-side opening without opening the doors. Requires stopped and no traction.
hint.emucab.door_close_left: Clears the left open signal and release without affecting the other side. No door-position feedback.
hint.emucab.door_open_right: Requires right release, stopped and no traction. Holds the open signal at 15 until the same-side close button is pressed.
hint.emucab.door_release_right: Enable right-side opening without opening the doors. Requires stopped and no traction.
hint.emucab.door_close_right: Clears the right open signal and release without affecting the other side. No door-position feedback.
hint.emucab.sunshade: Toggle the sunshade command; no shade model is connected.
hint.emucab.parking_apply: Apply while stopped and inhibit traction. The shared parking brake channel stays at 15 with the master key off until released. No actuator feedback.
hint.emucab.parking_release: Release the shared parking brake signal to 0, including with the master key off. Holding and emergency brakes remain independent.
hint.emucab.cleaning_brake: Request friction braking to clean the brake discs; no force or timing simulation is connected.
hint.emucab.holding_brake: Toggle a temporary standstill holding command; inhibits traction until released by another press.
hint.emucab.dsd: Driver vigilance acknowledgement request only; does not silence ATP or reset EB. No vigilance timer is connected.
hint.emucab.general_reset: Send a general equipment reset request without clearing EB, parking brakes or door interlocks.
hint.emucab.emergency_reset: Reset this desk EB latch only while stopped and in neutral; other interlocks remain active.
hint.emucab.passenger_alarm_bypass: Toggle a passenger alarm bypass request. Does not bypass driver EB, DSD or ATP.
hint.emucab.operating_mode: Independent selection request only; no manual, cruise or automatic mode is selected.
message.emucab.atp_no_desk: No loaded cab desk at that position
message.emucab.atp_unknown: Unknown ATP cue; use command completion
message.emucab.atp_unavailable: Not queued: check master key and ATP audio setting, or cue is already pending/playing
screen.emucab.throttle_target: Target: signal × step, capped by Create maximum
screen.emucab.throttle_scroll: Scroll to adjust nonzero ramp interval; Shift for fast steps; zero input stops immediately
message.emucab.sign_no_track: No unambiguous track. Look along the travel direction and sneak-use the track.
message.emucab.sign_bound: Track point and direction recorded. Release sneak to place the sign.
message.emucab.sign_select_first: Hold the sign, look along the travel direction and sneak-use the track first.
tooltip.emucab.speed_sign: Sneak-use rail to select point; place; empty-hand use to set km/h
tooltip.emucab.balise_install: Use on a full track block to install; empty hand to configure; Create wrench to remove
tooltip.emucab.balise_limit: Directional speed limit, effective after passing
screen.emucab.balise_full_track_only: Install on a full track block only
screen.emucab.mon_hint: Rear preferred; falls back to available bow
screen.emucab.mon_lower_hint: Changing isolation lowers bows; raise again
screen.emucab.mon_open_hint: Use to configure isolation; master key required
screen.emucab.throttle_step_hint: Target RPM per redstone level; ramp still changes 1 RPM at a time
message.emucab.telemetry_selected: Cab selected. Right-click a bogey or P&W pantograph to register its car.
message.emucab.telemetry_select_first: Select a cab with this tool first.
message.emucab.telemetry_saved: Telemetry registration updated; vehicle controls unchanged.
message.emucab.telemetry_failed: Registration failed: bogey or cab is no longer available.
emucab.motor.electrical: Measured voltage: %s V · Estimated load: %s W
